title: image-prompts
description: Image-generation prompt set for one article. `prompts` MUST be a JSON ARRAY of objects, each carrying a slot_id. It must NEVER be an object keyed by slot_id ({"cover": {...}}) — that shape silently broke chart-render, real-photo sourcing, the image-placeholder lint, and the publish gate before 2026-06-29. The schema-validate hook blocks a dict-shaped write at the source.
